source: The Cryptid Prom is here!
target: 神秘生物舞会，到了！

source: Anyone would think Monster Prom was enough pressure for anyone's heart.
target: 照理说，光是怪物舞会，就已经够让人的心脏受折腾了。

source: But nope, here we go again.
target: 可不，我们又来了一回。

source: And you know what? It's great. You make lots of cryptid friends, and it also has all the wonderful things that made Monster Prom so cool:
target: 而且你知道吗？这感觉棒极了。你交了好多神秘生物朋友，这儿也有让怪物舞会那么精彩的一切：

source: Romantic slow dancing; wacky hijinks; quality time with your friends...
target: 浪漫的慢舞、荒唐的胡闹、和朋友共度的美好时光……

source: You even help some cryptids that are super nervous about Prom. You went through this already, so you assure them they've got this!
target: 你还安慰了几个为舞会紧张得不行的神秘生物。毕竟你也是过来人，你向他们保证：没问题，你们能行！

source: Ah, Prom... you could do this again and again...
target: 啊，舞会……这种事，真想来了一次又一次……

source: (And you sorta can by just playing Monster Prom 1 again.)
target: （再玩一遍《怪物舞会1》，其实也就能做到了。）

source: You even have Moss as your link into Cryptid Academy.
target: 你甚至有莫斯，给你牵线搭桥，认识神秘生物学院的人。

source: He tells you all the hot gossip, which lets you know who's who around here.
target: 他把最热乎的八卦全告诉你，让你摸清这里的人物关系。

source: There are jocks, mean girls, party animals, and even a hot bad boy!
target: 体育生、刻薄女生、派对狂人，甚至还有个性感坏男孩！

source: He also tells you all the secrets to optimize your run at Cryptid Prom.
target: 他还告诉你，要怎样才能把这趟神秘生物舞会之旅，玩得最顺。

source: Which items to buy from the shop; which stats to maximize; the answers to the bathroom riddles...
target: 商店里该买哪些道具，哪项属性该堆满，厕所谜题的答案是什么……

source: This makes you think: Monster Prom was everything to you, but Cryptid Prom might be everything to other people.
target: 你不禁想到：怪物舞会，曾是你的整个世界。可对另一些人来说，神秘生物舞会才是一切。

source: How many other "Monster Proms" are out there?
target: 这世上，还有多少别人的“怪物舞会”呢？

source: Plant Prom? Hell Prom? Home Appliance Prom? Liam Prom? Prom but everyone is secretly robots controlled by raccoons?
target: 植物舞会？地狱舞会？家电舞会？李姆舞会？还是满场都是机器人、背地里全由浣熊操控的舞会？

source: There are millions of other people out there, living their little personal adventures with their own casts and goals...
target: 世上还有千千万万的人，有各自的伙伴、各自的目标，经历着属于自己的小小冒险……

source: You hope they're all winning!
target: 希望他们都能赢！

source: If all that wasn't enough, you're probably the coolest cats at Cryptid Prom.
target: 如果这些还不够，那你们大概还是神秘生物舞会，最酷的一帮人。

source: You helped not one, but several cryptids get here in time.
target: 你帮了不止一个，而是好几个神秘生物，及时赶到这里。

source: There's Blurry Betty... or you think it is. She's nowhere to be seen, but you guess she'll appear later in the prom pics.
target: 模糊贝蒂也在……你觉得她应该在。哪儿都看不见她，不过你猜，等舞会照片出来，她就会出现在里面。

source: There's that glitch dude. You keep a safe distance... just in case. You don't want to deal with any error message windows for now.
target: 那个故障老兄也在。以防万一，你还是跟他保持安全距离，暂时可不想再应付什么错误弹窗了。

source: And there's everyone you helped breach the containment facility.
target: 还有那些，你帮忙逃出收容设施的家伙。

source: There's the "Shy Dude", who's not so shy anymore! They're rocking some sandals, and everyone is complimenting them on their beautiful feet.
target: “害羞哥”已经没那么害羞了！一双凉鞋穿得风生水起，人人都在夸那双漂亮的脚。

source: You see the "Difficult-to-Destroy Dinosaur". They brought a date, and it's... BLOBERT?!
target: 你看见了“难以摧毁的恐龙”。还带了个舞伴，居然是……泡泡？！

source: Wowie! Someone might finally get destroyed tonight... wink!
target: 哇哦！今晚，某位终于要被“摧毁”了……眨眼！

source: And there's even the human! She looks like she's close to having a stroke. A while later, she is nowhere to be seen.
target: 甚至连那个人类都在！她看着快要中风了。过了一阵，就不见了踪影。

source: Has she been murdered, or did she get laid by a cryptid? It'll surely be both a creepypasta and horny gossip material by tomorrow!
target: 是被谋杀了，还是跟某个神秘生物睡了？等到明天，这事准能同时成为网络怪谈和桃色八卦的素材！

source: Basically, you all have a legendary night... which ends with a super cool musical number!
target: 总之，大家都度过了传奇般的一晚……最后，还有一段超酷的歌舞表演！

source: Cryptid Prom!
target: 神秘生物舞会！

source: You cross the magic portal and end up in a whimsical land full of magic.
target: 你穿过魔法传送门，来到一片奇妙的土地，到处都是魔法。

source: Apparently these domains were created by a powerful spell, years ago.
target: 据说，这片天地，是多年前由一道强大的咒语创造的。

source: What was the purpose of the spell? To imprison an ancient evil? To produce a source of power? To build a very big storage room?
target: 施咒是为了什么？囚禁古老的邪恶？创造一种能量来源？还是，盖一间超级大的储物室？

source: You may never know.
target: 你可能永远不会知道。

source: You only know one thing for sure: you're here now, and you're ready for a big adventure!
target: 你只确定一件事：既然已经来了，就准备好大冒险了！

source: This is where your road trip ends, but a whole new journey begins!
target: 公路旅行在此结束，一段全新的旅程，却刚刚开始！

source: Good thing you have the best adventurer of all with you: Aaravi Mishra.
target: 幸好，你身边有最棒的冒险家：阿拉维·米什拉。

source: She knows how to cook (stuff that's ACTUALLY edible, that is).
target: 她会做饭——做出来的东西，是真的能吃的那种。

source: She has, like, forty different weapons with her (how she carries them all is a mystery to you).
target: 她随身带着大概四十种武器，至于到底怎么带下的，你也搞不懂。

source: She has protagonist energy and bulky plot armor, which may keep you away from actual danger.
target: 她自带主角气场，还有厚得惊人的剧情护甲，说不定能让你躲开真正的危险。

source: Your chances of survival are way higher than if you were only here with Polly and Scott, that's for sure.
target: 可以肯定，跟只有波莉、斯科特陪着你比起来，活下去的机会大多了。

source: She was born to be the star of a quest like this...
target: 这样的冒险，她天生就该是主角……

source: ...but that might be good? Being the supporting character of someone else's journey for once sounds quite okay.
target: ……可这样也不错吧？偶尔在别人的旅程里当一回配角，听着也挺好。

source: And what's more: you've assembled an amazing party for this enterprise!
target: 更棒的是，你已经为这趟冒险，集结了一支超强队伍！

source: On the other side of the portal all your friends are waiting for you.
target: 传送门另一边，所有朋友都在等你。

source: There's Dahlia, the muscle of the team. Fierce, strong, and prone to song!
target: 达丽雅是队里的武力担当。凶猛、强壮，动不动还想唱两句！

source: There's Joy, the brains of the team. Brave, smart, and ready to start!
target: 乔伊是队里的智力担当。勇敢、聪明，随时准备出发！

source: And there's Calculester. He's a bard.
target: 还有计算斯基。他是个吟游诗人。

source: Different reasons have brought you here; but that doesn't matter anymore.
target: 你们来到这里，各有各的原因，可那已经不重要了。

source: The only thing that truly matters is that you're in this together now.
target: 真正重要的只有一件事：现在，你们并肩同行。

source: Adventure awaits!
target: 冒险在等着呢!

source: Glory to the Merkingdom!
target: 荣耀归于人鱼王国！

source: You've heard so much about this marvelous land full of wonders and blatant violations of basic monster rights.
target: 这片神奇的土地，你已经听说过太多：奇迹处处可见，怪物的基本权利也被公然侵犯。

source: The banquet is exquisite. There's tons of seafood served; it's a clever and delicious way of repurposing traitors to the crown.
target: 宴席精美绝伦，海鲜堆积如山。这是把背叛王室的人重新利用的好办法，既聪明，又美味。

source: They may have failed in their attempted coups, but they surely achieve a revolution in your mouth!
target: 他们发动政变或许没成功，却实实在在地，在你嘴里掀起了一场革命！

source: You attend royal balls; public executions; seahorse races...
target: 你参加皇家舞会，观看公开处决，还有海马赛跑……

source: Yes, you understand the many perils of romanticizing the extremely wealthy and their wasteful lifestyle...
target: 没错，你很清楚，美化那些超级富豪和他们挥霍无度的生活，有多危险……

source: ...but you had a long road trip, so you choose to be a class traitor if only for a few days.
target: ……可毕竟，你跑了这么长一趟公路旅行。就让自己当几天阶级叛徒吧。

source: A toast to all things fancy!
target: 为一切奢华，干杯！

source: What's more: you share all of this with your good friend, Miranda.
target: 更棒的是，好朋友米兰达，陪你一起享受了这一切。

source: She teaches you about Merkingdom culture and their many eccentric customs.
target: 她给你讲人鱼王国的文化，还有各种古怪的习俗。

source: Miranda often seems like a fish out of water, always oblivious to "the ways of the common people".
target: 米兰达总是搞不懂“平民的生活方式”，经常像条离了水的鱼，格格不入。

source: You've grown so used to her bubbly demeanor, it's almost outlandish to see her like this.
target: 你已经习惯了她天真活泼的模样，现在看她这副样子，反倒有些不可思议。

source: It makes you think: this seems like a whole new side of Miranda to you, and yet it is her "true side":
target: 你不禁想到：对你来说，这是米兰达全新的一面，可这才是她“真正的一面”：

source: A Miranda who's more confident and definitely in her element.
target: 更自信，在自己的天地里如鱼得水的米兰达。

source: She tells you that recently, she's been more critical of the ways of the merpeople and the ruling class.
target: 她告诉你，最近，她已经开始反思人鱼民众和统治阶级的做法。

source: And yet, she can't help but enjoy herself while she shares her world with you.
target: 可跟你分享自己的世界时，她还是忍不住，享受着这一切。

source: You have a most fantastic time together. Huzzah!
target: 你们一起度过了无比美妙的时光。万岁！

source: On your last day in the Merkingdom, they even host a big celebration just for you!
target: 在人鱼王国的最后一天，他们甚至专门为你们，办了一场盛大的庆典！

source: You're considered heroes in all the land, as you've come to the aid of not one, but THREE of the Vanderbilt sisters.
target: 全国都视你们为英雄。毕竟，你们帮过的范德比尔特姐妹，不是一位，而是三位。

source: Bellanda shares thrilling stories of the siege, mentioning that it was you who helped tip the balance in the Merkingdom's favor with your wits.
target: 贝兰达讲起惊险的围城故事，说正是你的机智，才帮人鱼王国扭转了局势。

source: Brigadier Beluga marvels everyone with the tale of how you were essential in finding Amanda in her spiritual retirement.
target: 贝卢加准将的故事，也让所有人惊叹：能找到在外灵修的阿曼达，你可是关键。

source: And Laudanda makes a toast, admitting that even if your ways were rather unorthodox, you managed to help secure an alliance with several Circles of Hell.
target: 劳丹达也举杯致意，承认你的办法，虽然不太走寻常路，却帮王国与好几层地狱，结成了同盟。

source: These misadventures have taught you A LOT about the Merkingdom.
target: 经历了这些倒霉又荒唐的冒险，你对人鱼王国，了解了太多。

source: They seem to be one of the few domains who still fight the most important war; the war that may decide monsterkind's fate...
target: 他们似乎是少数，还在打那场最重要战争的国度之一。那场战争，也许会决定怪物族群的命运……

source: But does that justify their many horrible ways?
target: 可是，这就能让他们那些可怕的做法，变得正当吗？

source: There must be a better way!
target: 一定有更好的办法!

source: You have much to think about, but these are complex issues you won't solve today.
target: 你还有很多事要想。可问题这么复杂，今天肯定解决不了。

source: Today, you will gracefully accept the glory you've earned.
target: 今天，你只需要大方地，接受自己赢来的荣耀。

source: Glory to the Merkingdom! Glory to you!
target: 荣耀归于人鱼王国！荣耀归于你！

source: Fuck yeah! Veranotone is here!
target: 太他妈爽了！维拉诺顿到了！
notes: polish pass 083: FIX; location name fix 001

source: Four nights back-to-back of awesome music!
target: 连续四晚，全是超棒的音乐！

source: You have the time of your life (and afterlife), attending all sorts of epic concerts:
target: 你度过了此生，还有死后，最快乐的时光，听遍各种精彩演出：

source: The sick beats of "MC Griffin"...
target: “MC Griffin”酷到炸的节拍……

source: The dreamy vibes of "The New Pornographers" and "Anni B Sweet"...
target: “The New Pornographers”和“Anni B Sweet”梦幻般的氛围……

source: The endless groove of "Dead/Mouse"...
target: “Dead/Mouse”无穷无尽的律动……

source: And the great moments go beyond the concerts too:
target: 而那些美好时刻，也不只在演出时发生：

source: You befriend your camp neighbors, you watch the sunrise together in chill afterparties, you adopt a stranger into your party group...
target: 你跟营地里的邻居交上朋友，在悠闲的续摊派对上一起看日出，还拉来个陌生人，加入你们的狂欢小队……

source: ...and all other sorts of highs!
target: ……以及，各种各样的嗨！

source: What an experience.
target: 真是了不起的体验。

source: And the best part is, this is an experience you get to share with your friends.
target: 最棒的是，这一切，你还能和朋友一起分享。

source: Scott gets drunk and helps some strangers sneak a delicious sandwich into the festival.
target: 斯科特 喝醉后 帮陌生人把美味的三明治偷偷带进音乐节

source: The strangers happen to be a group of eccentric billonaires! They shower Scott in all sort of VIP perks and invite you all to their yacht afterparty! Hooray!
target: 那些陌生人，居然是一群性格古怪的亿万富豪！他们给斯科特塞了一堆VIP福利，还邀请你们全员，去游艇上续摊！好耶！

source: And Polly vibes like never before. She vibes so strongly that by the second day she starts emanating some sort of ectoplasmic positive energy that uplifts everyone around her.
target: 波莉则嗨出了前所未有的境界。到了第二天，她甚至开始散发某种灵质正能量，带得周围所有人，都情绪高涨。

source: It's kinda like a viral infection, but good!
target: 有点像病毒感染，不过是好的那种！

source: And good ol' Liam... he gets to boast that he liked all these bands before they were cool... even the ones who aren't cool yet!
target: 还有咱们的老朋友李姆……他终于可以炫耀，自己早在这些乐队火之前，就喜欢他们了……连那些还没火的也算！

source: He actually introduces you to a couple of lesser-known bands that may become your new faves!
target: 不过，他确实给你介绍了几支冷门乐队，说不定就会成为你的新欢！

source: It's great to see him chilling for a change.
target: 难得看到他放松下来，真好。

source: How lucky are you that these are the people you get to call your friends?
target: 能有他们当朋友，你得多幸运啊？

source: A toast to them all!
target: 敬他们所有人!

source: But Veranotone is also special thanks to all the new friends you got to make.
target: 维拉诺顿之所以格外特别，也少不了你新交的这些朋友。
notes: polish pass 083: FIX; location name fix 001

source: You get to meet Summer, Macarena, and Cheese once again.
target: 你又见到了Summer、Macarena和Cheese。

source: They join you and teach you the true meaning of... PARTYING HARD!
target: 他们加入进来，让你见识了……什么才叫玩到疯！

source: You party as if there's no tomorrow, because as you know: YOLT (You Only Live Twice)!
target: 你们就当没有明天一样狂欢，毕竟你懂的：YOLT——人生只活两回！

source: Each of them share important lessons with you.
target: 他们每个人，都给你上了重要的一课。

source: Macarena reveals that she used to make plans for everything, and had her whole her life figured out... until a piece of a balcony broke off over her head and that was that.
target: Macarena说，她以前事事都做计划，整个人生都安排好了……直到头顶的阳台掉下一块，砸在她头上，一切就结束了。

source: So... planning and all is good, but you need to make peace with the fact life sometimes has its own plans. What are you gonna do?
target: 所以……计划当然好，可你也得接受，有时候生活自有它的安排。不然还能怎么办呢？

source: Sometimes you can rehearse a piece a hundred times; sometimes you gotta play it by ear... either way, just try to enjoy the music, you know?
target: 有时，一首曲子可以排练一百遍；有时，就得即兴演奏……不管哪种，试着享受音乐就好，对吧？

source: Summer confides that she left her life slowly, spending her last days in a hospital.
target: Summer悄悄告诉你，她离开这个世界的过程很缓慢，最后的日子，都在医院度过。

source: It gave her perspective: you never know when your final act will begin, so you should reconsider why you're delaying all that stuff you told yourself you'd be doing one day.
target: 那让她想明白了一些事：谁也不知道，人生的最后一幕何时开场。所以，那些总说“总有一天会做”的事，为什么还要往后拖？

source: Go out and just do it. Savor every bit of life!
target: 走出去，做就是了。好好品味生命的每一刻！

source: And Cheese? Cheese doesn't teach you a cool life lesson based on how he died. In fact, he was never "dead" a ghost: he was born a ghost!
target: 那Cheese呢？Cheese没有拿自己的死因，给你讲什么精彩的人生道理。其实，他根本就不是“死后”才变成鬼的：他生下来就是鬼！

source: But he does teach you a cool trick to eat a big sandwich without getting ketchup on your clothes.
target: 不过，他教了你一个妙招：怎么吃大三明治，才不会把番茄酱弄到衣服上。

source: Cheese for the win!
target: Cheese最棒！

source: These three ghosts really heighten Veranotone for you, reminding you to truly seize the day (and properly eat sandwiches).
target: 这三个幽灵，让维拉诺顿变得更加精彩。他们提醒你，要真正把握当下——还要好好吃三明治。
notes: polish pass 083: FIX; location name fix 001

source: VERANOTONE FOREVER!
target: 维拉诺顿万岁！
notes: polish pass 083: FIX; location name fix 001

source: KNIFE LAND! THE LAND OF FUN... AND KNIVES!
target: 刀子乐园！有快乐……还有刀！

source: You ride ALL the rides... TWICE!
target: 所有游乐设施，你都玩了……两遍！

source: They're awesome and deadly in equal parts.
target: 有多好玩，就有多致命。

source: There's not one, but TWO freefalls!
target: 自由落体项目，不是一个，而是两个！

source: There's The Pit Full of Spikes and the Guillotine, which let you keep a severed head as a silly memento.
target: 有“尖刺坑”和“断头台”，还能留下一颗断头，当作傻乎乎的纪念品。

source: There's also The Blender, The Pendulum, and a volcano!
target: 还有“搅拌机”“大摆锤”，以及一座火山！

source: (You're still unsure if the volcano was supposed to be a ride or if it was just a random volcano that happens to be there.)
target: （你到现在都没搞懂，那火山到底是游乐设施，还是刚好长在那儿的普通火山。）

source: And there's the Murder Mansion, with actual murder!
target: 还有“谋杀鬼屋”，里面真的会发生谋杀！

source: So much fun! And you even manage to survive, which is a big plus.
target: 太好玩了！你甚至还活着出来了，这点可是大加分。

source: KNIFE LAND FOREVER!
target: 刀子乐园万岁！

source: If that wasn't enough, Damien's there to spice up your time. You can't go to a knife-themed theme park and not bring him!
target: 如果还嫌不够，德魔也在，给你添了不少刺激。来刀主题的乐园，哪能不带上他！

source: You spend your days in Knife Land doing all sorts of shenanigans.
target: 在刀子乐园的日子里，你们干遍各种“胡闹事”。

source: (Which is how Damien refers to the multiple crimes and misdemeanors he pushes you to commit with him.)

source: Everyone is so happy to have arrived at %DESTINATION%.
target: 能到%DESTINATION%，大家都很开心。

source: Everyone but you, that is.
target: 除了你,其他人都是这样

source: You see, as you were getting closer, you realized you forgot your cool sunglasses at home!
target: 事情是这样的：快到的时候，你突然想起来，自己的酷墨镜，忘在家里了！

source: Dang... those sunglasses are so cool, and you wanted to wear them in the many pics you're sure to take at %DESTINATION%!
target: 唉……那副墨镜多酷啊。你本来还想，到了%DESTINATION%，肯定要拍好多照片，全戴着它！

source: It's... it's just some silly sunglasses. But then again, you feel they will cover all your insecurities with their mystifying awesomeness. Fake it 'til you make it!
target: 只是……只是一副傻墨镜而已。可你又觉得，它那神秘的酷劲儿，能遮住你所有的不自信。先装得自信，说不定就真有了！

source: So you finally decided it wouldn't be that bad to quickly hitchhike your way home and then back... how long could that take?
target: 所以最后，你决定，先搭便车回家拿一下，再回来，应该也没多大事……这能花多久？

source: (It took way longer than it was worth.)
target: （比它值得你花的时间，长得多。）

source: %DESTINATION% would be so much fun...
target: %DESTINATION%本来会很好玩……

source: ...if it wasn't for that expired burrito you ate.
target: ...要不是你吃了那个过期的卷饼.

source: EVERYONE told you not to eat it; that it couldn't be fresh after spending so much time under the sun.
target: 大家都劝你别吃，说那东西在太阳底下晒了那么久，怎么可能还新鲜。

source: But no, you had to be a stubborn idiot, as always.
target: 可你偏不，非得跟往常一样，当个固执的白痴。

source: The burrito fucks up your stomach so much that you start to get unstable.
target: 那卷饼把肠胃折腾得够呛，连你自己，都开始不稳定了。

source: Not only do you fart A LOT, but you also rupture the veil between realms. Classic expired burrito stuff (?).
target: 你不光狂放屁，还把世界之间的帷幕，给撕破了。过期卷饼的常规操作，是吧（？）。

source: As a result, you appear briefly in the Human Realm.
target: 于是，你短暂地出现在了人类世界。

source: And a brief appearance is enough for the FBI to detain you.
target: 可就这短短一下，就足够FBI把你抓走了。

source: I hope that burrito was worth it.
target: 希望那个卷饼，值得你付出这些。

source: (It wasn't.)
target: （不值得。）

source: Before you can get to %DESTINATION%, something strange happens.
target: 你还没到%DESTINATION%，怪事就发生了。

source: Light and noise surround you... it's like... a powerful machine rupturing realms...
target: 光芒和噪音包围了你……像是……某台强大的机器，正在撕开世界之间的屏障……

source: Through strange technology, humans manage to briefly trespass the veil between realms!
target: 靠着奇怪的技术，人类居然短暂地穿透了世界之间的帷幕！

source: And that's enough to capture you!
target: 而这，就足够把你抓走了！

source: They throw you into a place called... AREA 51.
target: 他们把你扔进一个叫……51区的地方。

source: Is this... your life now?
target: 这……就是你以后的生活了吗？

source: No, it doesn't need to be. Everywhere, your people, the nerds of the world, begin to sense that one of them is being held prisoner in Area 51.
target: 不，没必要这样。世界各地，你的同胞，那些阿宅们，开始感应到，他们中的一员，被关进了51区。

source: A plan starts brewing. A valiant resistance. The nerds won't stop... they will Naruto run to Area 51.
target: 一个计划开始酝酿。一场英勇的反抗。阿宅们不会罢休……他们要用火影跑，冲向51区。

source: Now you can't do anything but wait.
target: 现在，你能做的只有等。

source: Everyone is about to enjoy %DESTINATION%!
target: 大家马上就能在%DESTINATION%，好好玩一场了！

source: Everyone but you, since you get caught by the Monster FBI.
target: 除了你，因为你被怪物FBI抓了。

source: You tell them you're not a deity of destruction anymore. You don't seek the end of monsterkind. It's all good!
target: 你告诉他们，你已经不是毁灭之神了。你不想毁灭怪物族群。一切都挺好的！

source: "The... what now?"
target: “毁灭……你刚才说什么？”

source: The FBI seems to have no interest in your "old deity" days.
target: FBI好像对你以前当“古神”的日子，根本没兴趣。

source: They're here to arrest you because you've been writing fanfic so horny that the government has labeled it a form of dissent.
target: 他们来抓你，是因为你写的同人文，色到政府都把它，定性成了一种异议表达。

source: They ask you to stop; this is just a "cease and desist."
target: 他们只是发了封“停止侵害函”，让你别再写。

source: NEVER! The world needs your art; your horny, horny art!
target: 绝不！世界需要你的艺术，你那色情、色情的艺术！

source: Oh, well. They throw you in jail, then. You made your choice.
target: 哦，那行吧。他们把你扔进了监狱。选择，是你自己做的。

source: %DESTINATION%!
target: %DESTINATION%!

source: You're about to get extremely happy when you get a notification on your phone...
target: 你正准备高兴到起飞，手机却收到了一条通知……

source: ...THEY DISCONTINUED YOUR FAVORITE SODA FLAVOR!
target: ……你最爱的汽水口味，停产了！

source: What's the meaning of anything anymore?
target: 那这一切，还有什么意义？

source: Your life will never be the same.
target: 你的人生，再也回不去了。

source: You decide to do the only sensible thing: not join your friends and spend several days mourning the loss of your favorite soda flavor in the car.
target: 你做出了唯一明智的选择：不跟朋友一起玩了，留在车里，花上几天，哀悼你最爱的汽水口味。

source: WHYYYYY?! WHY DID THEY HAVE TO DISCONTINUE THE BEST SODA FLAVOR EVER MADE BY MAN OR MONSTER?!
target: 为什么——？！为什么要停产，人类或怪物有史以来，做出过的最好喝的汽水？！

source: Farewell... water-flavored soda. Sigh.
target: 永别了……水味汽水。唉。

source: %DESTINATION%, WOOHOO!
target: %DESTINATION%呜呼!

source: THESE WILL BE THE BEST DAYS OF YOUR LIFE!
target: 这几天，会是你人生中最快乐的日子！

source: Wait...
target: 等等……

source: These may as well be the literal best days of your life...
target: 这几天，也许真就是字面意义上，你此生最快乐的日子……

source: A peak that will never again be experienced.
target: 一个再也无法重来的巅峰。

source: Your life from now on will be a pale attempt to experience something as cool and fun as these days ahead.
target: 从此以后，你的人生，就只能徒劳地追逐，试图再次体验这几天的精彩和快乐。

source: And you will most likely fail, and be filled with sadness as you nostalgically look back on these days.
target: 你大概永远做不到，只能一边怀念这些日子，一边满心悲伤。

source: No... this will make you miserable in the long run.
target: 不……从长远看，这会让你很痛苦。

source: And because of that, you choose NOT to go to %DESTINATION%. You stay in the car while your friends go.
target: 所以，你决定，不去%DESTINATION%。朋友们都去了，你却留在车里。

source: Yes, this is a good idea. This will be worth it in time... yes.
target: 对，这是个好主意。时间会证明，这么做是值得的……对。

source: %DESTINATION%, woohoo!
target: %DESTINATION%呜呼!

source: This long, wacky road trip has all been worth it to finally go to %DESTINATION%!
target: 这一趟漫长又荒唐的公路旅行，都是为了终于来到%DESTINATION%。值了！

source: Except you are... NOT going to %DESTINATION%?! What?!
target: 可你……不去%DESTINATION%了？！什么？！

source: Apparently %DESTINATION% was all a lie to trick you into going to the vet.
target: 原来，去%DESTINATION%，只是骗你出门的借口。真正的目的，是带你看兽医。

source: But... it can't be a lie? You literally are at %DESTINATION%!
target: 可是……怎么会是骗我的？我们明明就到%DESTINATION%了啊！

source: True, but that was so the lie would hold water better. All of your friends will actually go to %DESTINATION%... while you go to the vet office next door.
target: 没错，可这样，谎话才更可信。朋友们真的会去%DESTINATION%……你去的，则是隔壁的兽医诊所。

source: Ugh.
target: 唉哟。

source: Finally! You've arrived at %DESTINATION%!
target: 终于！你到%DESTINATION%了！

source: You all get ready for the time of your life!
target: 大家都准备好，玩个毕生难忘了！

source: Wait, but what's that? There's a cool lamp post next to the entrance to %DESTINATION%.
target: 等等，那是什么？%DESTINATION%入口旁边，有根很酷的路灯柱。

source: Whoa... it is a really cool lamp post...
target: 哇……真是根特别酷的路灯柱……

source: You... like... gotta stay and check out this cool lamp post a bit more.
target: 你……就是……得留下来，再多看看这根酷路灯柱。

source: You tell your friends to keep going. You'll find them later.
target: 你让朋友们先走，自己过会儿就去找他们。

source: You never do.
target: 结果，你再也没去。

source: Lamp post: best destination ever!
target: 路灯柱：史上最佳目的地！

source: %DESTINATION%?
target: %DESTINATION%?

source: Fuck %DESTINATION%!
target: 去他妈的%DESTINATION%！

source: And fuck your friends!
target: 朋友们也滚一边去！

source: Look at this cool lamp post!
target: 看看这根酷路灯柱！

source: This lamp post was the destination all along! YES!
target: 原来，这根路灯柱，才是真正的目的地！没错！

source: Welcome to random lamp post, the hip destination for all the cool kidz!
target: 欢迎来到随便一根路灯柱，酷小孩们最时髦的打卡地！

source: Recently, you've found a lamp post. It is a REALLY cool lamp post.
target: 最近，你发现了一根路灯柱。特别酷的那种。

source: You've been spending lots of time with the lamp post.
target: 你花了好多时间，陪着那根路灯柱。

source: You've thought of bringing it to %DESTINATION% with you.
target: 你甚至想，把它一起带去%DESTINATION%。

source: Your friends told you that's a weird idea. It's a lamp post... not a love interest.
target: 朋友们说，这想法很怪。那是根路灯柱……又不是恋爱对象。

source: Your friends know nothing. Ignoramuses!
target: 朋友们懂个屁。无知之徒！

source: They don't get you like the lamp post gets you.
target: 他们哪有路灯柱懂你。

source: Fuck %DESTINATION% and fuck your friends. They probably just want to fuck the lamp post. Jealous assholes.
target: 去他妈的%DESTINATION%，朋友们也见鬼去吧。他们肯定就是想上这根路灯柱。嫉妒的混蛋们。

source: You proceed to make out with the lamp post.
target: 你抱着路灯柱，开始热吻。

source: Your life rocks.
target: 你这日子，棒极了。

source: %DESTINATION%, yay!
target: %DESTINATION%，好耶！

source: It'd be super fun if not for the fact that some strangers jump out and capture you.
target: 本来会很好玩，要不是几个陌生人突然跳出来，把你抓走的话。

source: What the fuck?
target: 这他妈什么情况？

source: Apparently it is the QA team, doing bugfixes on the game.
target: 原来是游戏测试团队，正在修复漏洞。

source: They found you, you fuckin' glitch, corrupting the files.
target: 他们逮到了你，这个破坏文件的操蛋故障。

source: Not anymore! You got bugfixed! Bye.
target: 现在可不行了！你被当成漏洞，修掉啦！拜。

source: %DESTINATION% would be fun if not for the QA team that suddenly appears to bugfix your ass.
target: %DESTINATION%本来会很好玩，可测试团队突然出现，要把你这个故障修掉。

source: They fix your ass out of existence.
target: 他们把你修得，彻底不存在了。

source: If you ask me, this is on you for choosing to play as a glitch instead of a regular character.
target: 要我说，这得怪你自己：放着正常角色不选，非要玩个故障。

source: You were never supposed to exist in this game! #SorryNotSorry
target: 你本来就不该出现在这游戏里！#抱歉但并不后悔

source: %DESTINATION% would be fun if not for the QA team that suddenly appears to bugfix your ass.
target: %DESTINATION%本来会很好玩，可测试团队突然出现，要把你这个故障修掉。

source: Your friends jump to your rescue, but they're stopped by the QA team.
target: 朋友们冲过来救你，却被测试团队拦了下来。

source: They explain that you're just a glitch, corrupting the memory files of the game.
target: 他们解释说，你不过是个故障，正在破坏游戏的记忆文件。

source: Slowly, your friends start realizing all their memories are indeed corrupted... their memories with you are all fake!
target: 朋友们渐渐发现，记忆果然被破坏了……跟你在一起的那些回忆，全是假的！

source: Come to think of it, they don't know you from anywhere. You're just a damned glitch who corrupted %HISHER% way into this road trip.
target: 仔细一想，他们压根就不认识你。你不过是个该死的故障，靠篡改数据，硬把%HISHER%存在塞进了这趟公路旅行。

source: It was all an error, but now it's fixed... by erasing you from existence. Bye!
target: 一切都是错误，不过现在修好了……办法就是，把你彻底抹除。拜拜！

source: Hooray, you made it to %DESTINATION% in one piece!
target: 好耶，你完完整整地到了%DESTINATION%！

source: But as soon as you arrive, you get a horrible feeling in the pit of your stomach.
target: 可一到地方，你胃里就涌起一股，特别糟的感觉。

source: What happened? Why are you suddenly filled with the shame and humiliation?
target: 怎么回事？为什么突然觉得，这么羞耻、这么丢脸？

source: Why does it feel like you just waved at someone who was actually waving at the person behind you?!
target: 怎么像是你冲着人家挥手，结果人家招呼的，其实是你身后的人？！

source: There's only one explanation... you got the Bad Ending.
target: 解释只有一个……你拿到坏结局了。

source: Why? Who knows? You're the one who lost. I'm just the bearer of bad news.
target: 为什么？谁知道？输的人是你，我只是负责报个坏消息。

source: Better luck next time!
target: 祝你下次好运!

source: Yay, you've finally reached %DESTINATION%!
target: 耶,你终于到了 %DESTINATION%!

source: As soon as the car is parked, Polly shouts, "LAST ONE OUT IS A LAME LOSER!"
target: 车刚停稳，波莉就大喊：“最后一个下车的，是逊咖！”

source: Everyone bolts out of the car... except for you. Everyone points and laughs.
target: 所有人都冲下了车……除了你。大家全指着你笑。

source: Not cool! You had your headphones on and didn't hear Polly! It's not faaair!
target: 这可不行！你戴着耳机，没听见波莉说话啊！太不公平了！

source: But rules are rules: you will forever be known as the Lame Loser of the road trip.
target: 可规矩就是规矩：从今以后，你永远都是这趟公路旅行的逊咖。

source: Sucks to be you!
target: 你可真够惨的！

source: You made it to %DESTINATION%!
target: 你到%DESTINATION%了！

source: You'd be living it up right now if you didn't just remember that you've secretly been an animatronic this whole time.
target: 你本来应该正在尽情享受，可你突然想起来，自己一直都是个伪装的机械玩偶。

source: What? It doesn't make any sense? Sure, maybe it's not canon and just a joke for joke's sake; but you know what? Animatronics don't get to ask this many questions.
target: 什么？这不合理？行吧，也许这不算正史，只是为了搞笑而搞笑。可你知道吗？机械玩偶，没资格问这么多问题。

source: Now you have to be shut down for everyone's safety.
target: 现在，为了大家的安全，只能把你关机了。

source: What a bad ending, huh?
target: 真是个糟糕的结局,是吧?

source: Hooray, you made it to %DESTINATION% without any major disasters!
target: 好耶，一路没出什么大灾难，你终于到%DESTINATION%了！

source: You step out of the car to take a breath of fresh air...
target: 你下车呼吸新鲜空气...

source: ...and accidentally slip straight through a sewer grate.
target: ……一不留神，整个人从下水道格栅的缝里，滑了进去。

source: This is why slimes should never walk around outside barefoot, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 所以说，史莱姆真不该光着脚在外面走，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: By the time the firemen finally rescue you, your friends have had their fun and are ready to go home.
target: 等消防员终于把你救上来，朋友们早就玩够了，正准备回家。

source: You missed everything. Also, you smell like sewer. Not your finest work.
target: 你什么都错过了，还一身下水道味。真不是你的高光时刻。

source: You finally reached %DESTINATION%... or, at least, your friends did.
target: 你终于到了%DESTINATION%……或者说，至少朋友们到了。

source: You, on the other hand, accidentally dropped your ultra-rare gold Dalulu keychain down a sewer grate!
target: 而你，不小心把超稀有的金色达鲁鲁钥匙扣，掉进了下水道格栅！

source: You obviously couldn't let that slide, so you told your friends to go on without you and you'd catch up later.
target: 那当然不能就这么算了。你让朋友们先走，自己过会儿再追上来。

source: It took forever to find your keychain, and it took even longer for you to climb out of the sewer.
target: 你找钥匙扣，找了半天。等到要爬出下水道，花的时间还更长。

source: By then, your friends had already left %DESTINATION% and looped back around to pick you up.
target: 那时候，朋友们早就离开%DESTINATION%，绕回来接你了。

source: At least you got your precious Dalulu back, and it only kinda smells like pee. Worth it...?
target: 至少，你找回了珍贵的达鲁鲁，而且只带了一点尿味。值吗……？

source: Yay, you made it to %DESTINATION%!
target: 好耶，你到%DESTINATION%了！

source: You're walking at the back of the pack, watching your friends and thinking about how lucky you are to be in their lives...
target: 你走在队伍最后，看着朋友们，想着能成为他们生命里的一部分，自己有多幸运……

source: Then a crazy sewer clown grabs your ankle!
target: 然后一个疯狂的下水道小丑抓住你的脚踝!

source: He drags you into the depths, saying "MMMM, JELLO" as you scream for help.
target: 他一边把你往深处拖，一边念叨：“嗯——果冻。”你则拼命尖叫求救。

source: It's hours before your friends realize you're gone, which is the final blow to your already-battered ego.
target: 过了好几个小时，朋友们才发现你不见了。你本就备受打击的自尊，又挨上了最后一刀。

source: You didn't have "fighting off a sewer clown who wants to eat your toes" on your road trip bingo card... and you wish you still didn't.
target: “跟一个想吃你脚趾的下水道小丑搏斗”，原本可不在你的旅行宾果卡上……你真希望，现在也不在。

source: Yes, you finally reached %DESTINATION%.
target: 是的,你终于到了 %DESTINATION%.

source: It's nice to see your whole road trip come to fruition.
target: 很高兴看到你的整趟出行圆满成功

source: Before you get there, you take a moment to breathe and think of all the wonderful memories you and your friends have created together.
target: 快到的时候，你稍稍停下来喘口气，想起这一路，和朋友共同留下的美好回忆。

source: So many misadventures, new friends, and shenanigans of all kinds!
target: 那么多倒霉又荒唐的冒险，新朋友，还有各种各样的胡闹！

source: This trip was a cocktail of emotions.
target: 这趟旅行，就像一杯混合了各种情绪的鸡尾酒。

source: And you, for one, have really enjoyed getting to drink it to the last drop!
target: 而你，确实享受着它，一直喝到了最后一滴！

source: After so much road-tripping, here you are: %DESTINATION%!
target: 跑了这么久，你终于来了：%DESTINATION%！

source: For a hot second you thought you would never arrive.
target: 有那么一瞬，你还以为，永远都到不了了。

source: You're so hyped to be here!
target: 能来这儿，你激动得不行！

source: ...and yet...
...although you're sure you'll enjoy %DESTINATION% a lot...
target: ……你很确定，在%DESTINATION%肯定会玩得超开心……

source: ...you realize what they say is true, as corny as it sounds:
target: ……可你也发现，那句话虽然老土，却是真的：

source: It's not about the destination, it's the journey.
target: 重要的不是目的地，而是沿途的旅程。

source: Whatever cheesy bastard said that, they were hella right.
target: 也不知道是哪个俗气混蛋说的，可他妈的，真说对了。

source: What a road trip!
target: 多棒的一趟公路旅行！

source: %DESTINATION%, here we go!
target: %DESTINATION%，我们来啦！

source: As you and your friends run excitedly to the entrance, you look back at Polly and Scott.
target: 你和朋友们兴奋地冲向入口，又回头看看波莉和斯科特。

source: How lucky are you that these two thought of you when planning this road trip?
target: 这两个人，计划公路旅行的时候，会想到叫上你。你得有多幸运啊？

source: You think of all the fantastic adventures you've had together...
target: 想想你们一起经历的奇妙历险...

source: ...the new friends you made; the unforgettable moments you experienced...
target: ……交到的新朋友，经历过的难忘时刻……

source: ...and it's all thanks to a single text asking you to join them!
target: ……而这一切，都始于一条邀请你同行的短信！

source: It's nice to think that when they were envisioning such an epic journey, Polly and Scott thought you would be a key element of it.
target: 一想到波莉和斯科特，在设想这趟精彩旅程时，觉得其中少不了你，心里就暖暖的。

source: There's a sweetness in realizing your friends think of you and want you to be part of their most memorable moments.
target: 原来，朋友们会惦记你，希望最难忘的时刻里，也有你在。这种感觉，真甜。

source: Ahh, life is good!
target: 啊，活着真好！

source: So much hassle finally paid off! You got to %DESTINATION%!
target: 折腾了这么久，总算值了！你到%DESTINATION%了！

source: This has been thrilling, enriching, and dare I say... life-changing?
target: 这一路，有刺激、有收获，我甚至敢说……改变了你的人生？

source: You feel like you're a different person, in a way.
target: 某种意义上，你觉得自己，已经跟以前不一样了。

source: Yes, you're at %DESTINATION%, but now you realize the road trip isn't really its destination...
target: 没错，你到了%DESTINATION%。可现在你发现，公路旅行真正重要的，不是目的地……

source: ...dang, the road trip isn't even really the journey!
target: ……嚯，甚至连旅程本身都不是！

source: No, no...
target: 不，不……

source: You finally see that...
target: 你终于明白了……

source: ...the road trip is the friends we made along the way.
target: ……公路旅行，就是我们沿途交到的朋友。

source: Does that make sense? No? Who cares, anyway?
target: 这说得通吗？不通？管它呢？

source: As you get ready to enter %DESTINATION%, you see your friends, laughing in excitement.
target: 你准备走进%DESTINATION%，看见朋友们兴奋地笑着。

source: Look at Polly and Scott, always full of excitement and joy.
target: 看看波莉和斯科特，永远那么兴奋，那么快乐。

source: Sure, they're reckless, chaotic, and may or may have not caused the end of the world more than once...
target: 他们确实鲁莽、爱添乱，甚至可能，也可能没有，不止一次引发过世界末日……

source: But they have this overwhelming positive energy that's so easy to like.
target: 可那股扑面而来的积极劲儿，实在让人很难不喜欢。

source: Over the course of this trip, you've gotten to know them better, and it's nice to see them smile at every challenge life throws at them.
target: 这趟旅行，让你更了解他们了。不管生活丢来什么挑战，他们总能笑着面对，看着就觉得好。

source: Maybe you can do that for a change, too...
target: 说不定，你偶尔也能试着这样……

source: You could stop always taking everything so seriously and just laugh when things go wrong, as life will just continue.
target: 别总把所有事看得那么严肃。出了岔子，就笑一笑，反正日子还会继续。

source: This way you're in on the big, incomprehensible joke that life is... a twisted funny thing that should bring us all a bit more joy, a bit more laughter.
target: 这样，你也能领会人生这个巨大又莫名其妙的笑话……它扭曲又好笑，本来就该让我们多开心一点，多笑几声。

source: Finally! %DESTINATION%!
target: 终于来了!  %DESTINATION%!

source: This is so important to you... it's hard to explain.
target: 这对你很重要... 这很难解释。

source: Well, actually it's not. You see:
target: 不，其实挺好解释的。事情是这样：

source: You've been holding in gas for the last three stops, since you didn't want to fart in front of your friends.
target: 前面三站，你一直在憋屁，因为不想在朋友面前放出来。

source: Hey, it's only normal!
target: 嘿,这很正常!

source: But now you're here, and you can see your friends heading to %DESTINATION%...
target: 可现在终于到了，朋友们已经朝%DESTINATION%走去……

source: They're so happy... and you will join them in a minute.
target: 他们很高兴……你也马上就会跟上。

source: But first you fart.
target: 可在那之前，你先放了个屁。

source: It's one of the most releasing things you will ever experience.
target: 这可能是你这辈子，最畅快的一次释放。

source: Sometimes it's the little things that matter.
target: 有时候，重要的就是这些小事。

source: You're also incredibly proud of yourself for holding it for this long. It shows much constraint and discipline.
target: 能憋这么久，你也特别骄傲。这充分体现了你的克制和自律。

source: You've truly grown up during this trip. You're now a different person.
target: 这趟旅行，真的让你成长了。现在，你已经不一样了。

source: A person with less gas.
target: 变成了一个，肚子里少点气的人。

source: You're so happy to reach %DESTINATION%!
target: 到%DESTINATION%了，你开心得不得了！

source: You realize this adventure has been much easier to enjoy.
target: 你发现，这次冒险，要玩得开心，轻松多了。

source: School and summer camp were great... but there was so much pressure.
target: 学校和夏令营都很棒... 但压力太大了

source: Would you get a date to prom? A date for the meteor shower? Always with the stressful countdown!
target: 能约到舞伴吗？流星雨那晚，有人约会吗？永远都有个让人紧张的倒计时！

source: But here? Here, fuck all that!
target: 可在这儿？去他妈的这些破事！

source: It's just you and the road.
target: 只有你和那条路

source: You living adventures while kissing the sweet asphalt.
target: 你亲吻着那美妙的柏油路，一路冒险。

source: Ah, yes... the sexy, sexy road...
target: 啊,对了... 性感又性感的马路...

source: ...you wonder if the road would agree to a date...
target: ……也不知道，这条路愿不愿意跟你约会……

source: ...no! Wait! Ah, you're scarred for life... you need to stop trying to date everything...
target: ……不！等等！啊，过去的经历，都给你留下一辈子的阴影了……你得改改，别看见什么都想约会……

source: It will take time, but you'll get there.
target: 需要一点时间，可你会做到的。

source: And this feels like a great start!
target: 而这，就是个很好的开始！

source: %DESTINATION%, at last!
target: %DESTINATION%终于来了!

source: For a moment you were sure you wouldn't make it.
target: 有那么一瞬，你还以为，自己没法活着到这儿。

source: This has been a true feat of survival!
target: 这真是生存的壮举!

source: You almost ran out of %LOWRESOURCE%...
target: 你的%LOWRESOURCE%，差点就用光了……

source: ...you survived a coyote attack...
target: ……你从郊狼的攻击下，活了下来……

source: ...you ate a rock...
target: ...你吃了一块石头...

source: And yet, here you are!
target: 可最后，你还是到了！

source: A more experienced version of yourself.
target: 成为了更有经验的自己。

source: You're stronger, you're wiser, you're sexier!
target: 你更坚强,你更聪明,你更性感!

source: You can feel it in your blood.
target: 你能感觉到，血液里都有这股变化。

source: (Although it might just be the rock you ate.)
target: （也可能，只是你吃的那块石头。）

source: Welcome to the new %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! A new era begins!
target: 欢迎全新的%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！一个新时代，开始了！

source: Whoa! You're really here!
target: 呜呼! 你真的在这里!

source: You take a moment to reflect on all the wacky misadventures that have brought you here...
target: 你稍稍停下来，回想那些把你带到这里的，荒唐又倒霉的冒险……

source: There's that time you almost lost your nose while stopping at the %LASTLOCATION%...
target: 在%LASTLOCATION%停留的时候，你差点把鼻子弄没了……

source: And that other time when you managed to fit A WHOLE LOT of pistachios in your mouth!
target: 还有一次，你居然往嘴里，塞进了一大堆开心果！

source: A truly impressive feat, especially considering your acute nut allergy.
target: 考虑到你对坚果严重过敏，这确实是个了不起的壮举。

source: There was also that time you went the whole day without wearing pants, because fuck pants.
target: 还有一回，你整整一天都没穿裤子，因为去他妈的裤子。

source: Ah, yes... this has been a truly formative and life-changing experience.
target: 啊，没错……这确实是段让人成长、改变人生的经历。

source: You look back on all those important moments... they may stay with you for the rest of your life.
target: 你回望那些重要时刻……它们也许会陪你一辈子。

source: And in doing so, this road trip will last forever.
target: 这样一来，这趟公路旅行，也就永远不会结束。

source: Ah, what a road trip!
target: 啊,这趟路真不赖!

source: It has been profoundly enriching.
target: 它让你受益匪浅。

source: You've learned a lot of lessons that have turned you into a different, better person.
target: 你学到了那么多，让自己变成了一个更好、也不同于从前的人。

source: You take a minute to look back and remember all those important lessons...
target: 你稍稍停下来，回味那些重要的人生道理……

source: Even in your lowest moments, you must remember: life just goes on.
target: 再低落的时候，也要记得：生活还会继续。

source: Never eat a rock. Like... why did you that in the first place?
target: 永远别吃石头。不是……你当时到底怎么想的？

source: Sometimes the solution to your problems was a taxi license all along!
target: 有时候，解决问题的关键，其实一直都是一张出租车执照！

source: Horsies sometimes hide more than meets the eye.
target: 小马有时候，可不像表面看起来那么简单。

source: A good skin care routine is VERY IMPORTANT.
target: 好好护肤，非常重要。

source: Saturn is, despite what you might have thought, a planet.
target: 不管你以前怎么想，土星，确实是一颗行星。

source: It's important to know when to stop listing things.
target: 知道什么时候该停止列举，也很重要。

source: While your friends head towards %DESTINATION%, you hang back by the car for a bit.
target: 朋友们走向%DESTINATION%，你却先留在车边，待了一会儿。

source: Ah, this car, this precious car! The true MVP of this road trip, despite what anyone else might say.
target: 啊，这辆车，这辆宝贝车！甭管别人怎么说，它才是这趟旅行真正的MVP。

source: You pat your trusty metal steed in a gesture of deep appreciation.
target: 你拍拍这位可靠的金属坐骑，表达满心谢意。

source: It's guided you through the long, inhospitable roads.
target: 是它，带你走过漫长又荒凉的道路。

source: It's been with you during the many times you almost died.
target: 你那么多次差点没命，它都陪在身边。

source: The car would never betray you. The car is reliable and durable and solid.
target: 这辆车绝不会背叛你 车体可靠而耐用并坚固.

source: You get close to one of its many tubes and whisper:
target: 你凑近它其中一根管子，轻声说：

source: "Thank you, Car."
target: "谢谢你,汽车。"

source: "You're welcome, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%."
target: “不客气，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。”

source: ...What?
target: 什麽?

source: Yes, you did it!
target: 对,你成功了!

source: Not only that, you did it in true, full-balanced co-op!
target: 而且，这是场真正贡献均衡的合作胜利！

source: So nice, so fair...
target: 这么好,那么公平...

source: This fills you with joy.
target: 这让你充满了欢乐。

source: But to be completely fair, it fills you with the exact same amount of joy as your friends'.
target: 不过，为了绝对公平，这份快乐，跟朋友们得到的，得一模一样多。

source: Not a drop more, not a drop less.
target: 不多一滴,不少一滴.

source: Your sense of accomplishment is in full balance with that of all the other people responsible for this victory.
target: 你的成就感，也和其他所有共同赢下这场胜利的人，分毫不差。

source: You're so perfectly balanced and in sync that after doing this, the only logical next step is to start a dance troupe together.
target: 你们配合得如此均衡、如此同步，下一步唯一合乎逻辑的事，就是一起成立舞团。

source: This way you can keep milking how in sync you all are.
target: 这样，就能继续靠这份默契，发挥余热。

source: Yes, you will do that! And the troupe's name will be "The Kitchen Sync"!
target: 对，就这么办！舞团就叫“厨房洗舞池”！

source: Celebrate this by rehearsing your first dance number. Go!
target: 排练第一支舞，庆祝一下吧。动起来！

source: Yes, you did it!
target: 对,你成功了!

source: This is the epitome of teamwork!
target: 这就是团队合作的典范！

source: Look at all of you, each of you essential to the victory of this wacky adventure!
target: 看看你们，少了谁，这场荒唐的冒险，都赢不下来！

source: A toast to the greatest team ever!
target: 为有史以来最伟大的团队干杯!

source: ...Wait. You need a team name!
target: ……等等。你们得有个队名！

source: We asked you for your individual names, but who cares about your individual names?
target: 我们问了你们每个人的名字，可谁还在乎个人名字啊？

source: You didn't beat this as individuals, but AS A TEAM!
target: 赢下来的，可不是各自为战的你，而是整支队伍！

source: C'mon, come with your road trip team name. Not to confuse with your dance troupe name ("The Kitchen's Sync").
target: 来，给这趟公路旅行的小队起个名。别跟舞团名字“厨房洗舞池”搞混了。

source: It needs to be clever, sharp, awesome... probably a pun of sorts...
target: 要机灵、要犀利、要酷……大概还得来点双关……

source: (Five minute pause to brainstorm the road trip team name...)
target: （暂停五分钟，想想公路旅行小队的名字……）

source: You got it? Perfect!
target: 想到了？完美！

source: And remember: if you leave a good review (they help a lot), include your team's name and compare it to other players'.
target: 记住，如果你们愿意留个好评，那真的帮大忙，把队名也写进去，跟其他玩家比比！

target: 现在，再来一次：敬史上最棒的队伍——大声喊出你们的队名！

source: Yes, you did it!
target: 对,你成功了!

source: And what's more important: you did it together.
target: 而更重要的是，你们是一起做到的。

source: This has been the ultimate feat of friendship and teamwork.
target: 这就是友谊与团队合作的终极壮举。

source: And as such, your friendship has officially ascended to the next level.
target: 因此，你们的友谊，正式升入了下一个等级。

source: Yeah, you heard me right: now your friendship is next level, so you must do the following things:
target: 对，没听错。友谊升级了，所以下面这些事，你们必须做到：

source: Come up with a very secret handshake only for the people present today.
target: 想一套秘密握手动作，只有今天在场的人才会。

source: Buy something cheap and silly for all of you to keep as adorable mementos of this day.
target: 买点便宜又傻气的小玩意儿，每人留一份，当作今天可爱的纪念品。

source: If you write a review for this game (they help a lot), include an ode to all the ways in which the other players were awesome and essential to the victory.
target: 如果你为这游戏写评论，那真的帮大忙，记得好好歌颂其他玩家：他们有多棒，对胜利有多不可或缺。

source: And last but not least, promise you will invite each other to your respective weddings if applicable.
target: 最后，还得答应彼此：谁要是结婚，一定邀请大家来。

source: No, wait: you will ENSURE you will be each other's best man/maid of honor/distinguished guest! Fuck any previous meaningful relationships! THIS IS THE IMPORTANT ONE NOW!
target: 不，等等：你们得确保，自己能当彼此的首席伴郎、首席伴娘，或者贵宾！以前那些重要关系，去他妈的！现在，这段才最重要！

source: And you are FORCED to give the best speech ever for each other.
target: 而且，必须为彼此，献上史上最棒的致辞。

source: It must be funny, intimate, emotive, and include at least seven references to this epic road trip (and three inside jokes indecipherable to anyone who wasn't here today).
target: 要好笑、要亲密、要感人，至少提七次这趟精彩的公路旅行，还得塞三个，只有今天在场的人才能听懂的小梗。

source: ULTIMATE FRIENDSHIP!
target: 终极友谊！

source: Yes, you did it!
target: 对,你成功了!

source: And you did it TOGETHER.
target: 你们一起完成的。

source: This was an achievement that could only be truly accomplished through extreme cooperation.
target: 这样的成就，只有靠极致合作，才能真正达成。

source: Now, you must all double down on this and commit to live a life of extreme cooperation.
target: 现在，你们得再接再厉，把极致合作，贯彻到整个人生。

source: From now on, you'll all do all your daily tasks cooperatively.
target: 从今往后，所有日常任务，都得合作完成。

source: Play all games in co-op mode. Even single player games: divide control of the game equally among all of you.
target: 所有游戏，都开合作模式。单机游戏也一样：操作权平分，谁都有份。

source: Create a group chat. From now on, all life choices must be chosen democratically by the group.
target: 建个群聊。从此以后，人生所有决定，都得全员民主投票。

source: Share all your clothing; mix and match!
target: 衣服全都共享，随便混搭！

source: Eat breakfast cooperatively, feeding the other person eating while you're being fed by them in perfect sync.
target: 合作吃早餐：你喂对方，对方喂你，动作完美同步。

source: Leave your individual selves behind... embrace the hive mind...
target: 抛开个人自我……拥抱蜂群意识……

source: This is you now. This is good.
target: 从此，你们就这样了。挺好。

source: The music festival is the FUCKIN' BEST!
target: 这音乐节，真他妈太棒了！

source: Polly and Scott prefer not to plan too far ahead and go with the flow when it comes to which concerts to attend...
target: 看哪场演出，波莉和斯科特一向不爱提前规划太多，更愿意随兴决定……

target: ……所以，当他们一看，发现下一场演出居然是……

source: ...YOURS?!
Yup, you started a band some months ago but chose to keep it low-profile.
target: 没错，几个月前，你组了支乐队，不过一直很低调。

source: It's been snowballing to the point where you were invited to perform here, and you thought it'd be way cooler if you told no one beforehand.
target: 乐队就这么一点点火起来，甚至收到了这里的演出邀请。你觉得，提前谁也不告诉，惊喜才够酷。

source: While everyone is still processing your secret famous life, you hit the stage and...
target: 大家还在消化，你居然背着他们当了明星这件事，你已经走上舞台……

source: KICK SERIOUS ASS!
target: 炸翻全场！

source: It's an electrifying concert where you shock the audience with your high-voltage voice!
target: 这场演出电力十足，你一开口，高压嗓音就把观众全电翻了！

source: As you pour your heart and soul into the music, you realize this moment will live on forever.
target: 你把全部身心倾注进音乐，也明白，这一刻，将永远留存。

source: You have now ascended. Now, you are half a person...
target: 你就此升华。如今，你一半是人……

source: ...and half a fuckin' legend.
target: ……一半，是他妈的传奇。

source: The music festival is the FUCKIN' BEST!
target: 这音乐节，真他妈太棒了！

source: You make new friends and live some unforgettable moments.
target: 你交了新朋友，留下了一段段难忘时光。

source: But maybe the most unforgettable moment of all happens at the end of one of the concerts on the last night...
target: 可最难忘的一刻，大概发生在最后一晚，某场演出结束的时候……

source: As the band finishes their set, it's the classic moment where the audience asks for an encore.
target: 乐队刚演完，照例到了观众喊安可、要求返场的时候。

target: 波莉一肚子恶作剧点子，开始带头喊：“%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%！%CURRENTPLAYERNAMECAPS%！”

target: 斯科特当然跟着喊。几个醉鬼也学起来，压根不知道，他妈的这是什么意思。

source: The situation snowballs with people unsure what's going on...
target: 事情越闹越大，大家虽然不明所以……

target: 你们裹着毯子，依偎在车里，什么都聊，又像什么也没聊……

source: What a trip, huh? There are times when I'm not even sure we will survive it.
target: 这趟旅行，真够折腾的，对吧？有时候，我都不确定，咱们还能不能活下来。

source: Right? I feel like that half of the time since I came to live in the Monster Realm...
target: 是吧？自从来怪物世界生活，我有一半时间，都有这种感觉……

source: It's fun, but a bit dizzying!
target: 挺好玩的，可也让人有点晕头转向！

source: ...Do you ever miss the Human Realm?
target: ……你会想念人类世界吗？

source: Constantly.
target: 一直都想。

source: I've lived there all my life... plus all my family is still there.
target: 以前，我一直住在那里……家人也都还在那儿。

source: So much left behind...
target: 那么多东西，都留在身后了……

source: Vicky... I'm sorry... that sounds incredibly hard.
target: 薇姬……对不起……那一定，很难熬。

source: Yeah...
The first year was definitely harsh.
target: 第一年，确实不好过。

source: But you know, I try to always focus on the bright side of things.
target: 不过你知道，我总想试着，多看看好的一面。

source: I weathered that first year, and now I live as if this is all the big adventure of moving to a new place all by myself.
target: 我熬过了第一年，现在，就把这一切，当成自己独自搬去新地方的，一场大冒险。

source: Vicky vs. adult life!
target: 薇姬，大战成年生活！

source: Haha... exactly!
target: 哈哈……没错！

source: And you know what? For all the loved ones left behind, I'm grateful to meet so many new people I like!
target: 而且你知道吗？虽然离开了那么多爱的人，但能遇见这么多喜欢的新朋友，我还是很感激！

source: ...Like you.
target: ……比如你。

source: She curls up closer to you, pressing her head against your chest.
target: 她蜷着身子，又靠近一点，把头贴在你的胸前。

source: It's admirable how she has faced such big hardships and yet remained this positive.
target: 经历过那么难的事，还能这么乐观，真让人佩服。

source: Dang... you too are grateful to have met her... and as you think about it, you two fall asleep together.
target: 你也很庆幸，能认识她……想着这些，你们就这样，一起睡着了。

source: %DESTINATION% is cool and all that, but you know what's cooler? The fact that tonight, you and Brian had sex.
target: %DESTINATION%当然很棒，可你知道，什么更棒吗？今晚，你和布赖恩做爱了。

source: WHAT. A. NIGHT.
target: 多。棒。的。一。晚。

source: Now, the two of you are just chilling, talking after the deed.
target: 现在，做完之后，你们就这么放松地，聊着天。

source: Whoa... that was... something.
target: 哇……刚才……真不一般。

source: Yeah...
The two of you are breathing hard, covered in sweat...
target: 你们还喘着气，满身都是汗……

source: For someone so zen, Brian sure knows how to get wild.
target: 平时淡定成这样，布赖恩疯起来，倒是相当在行。

source: Maybe he stores the energy for this sort of thing?
target: 难道平时攒的精力，都留给这种事了？

source: It's fun, isn't it?
target: 这很有趣,不是吗?

source: What's fun?
target: 有什么好玩的吗?

source: I've spent most of the trip wondering if I should make a move... like, I wasn't sure if you were into me.
target: 这一路，我大半时间，都在纠结要不要主动点……就是，不确定，你是不是喜欢我。

source: I was... I am.
target: 之前就喜欢……现在也喜欢。

source: Yeah... I guess sometimes I get too much in my own head.
target: 嗯……我可能，有时确实想太多了。

source: I get you. I'm like that too.
target: 我懂，我也这样。

source: But then I remind myself: life can be simpler.
target: 但我提醒自己:生活可以简单一些。

source: How so?
target: 怎么说？

source: Well, look at us: you like me, I like you... it can be as simple as that.
target: 你看咱们：你喜欢我，我喜欢你……就能这么简单。

source: No need to overthink... just being true to ourselves...
target: 不用想太多……忠于自己就好……

source: As simple as that, huh? Two people liking each other...
target: 就这么简单，嗯？两个人，互相喜欢……

source: ...and having a good time.
target: ……一起开心。

source: Yeah, I like the sound of that.
target: 嗯，听着就不错。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%...
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%...

source: Yes?
target: 嗯？

source: I might fall asleep soon, okay? Before I pass out, I wanted to tell you I'm glad this happened.
target: 我可能快睡着了，可以吧？趁还没睡过去，想告诉你，今晚这样，真好。

source: Me too...
target: 我也一样...

source: Let's have some more fun in the morning...
target: 我们早上再玩玩...

source: I like the sound of that too...
target: 这个，听着也不错……

source: And so, the two of you slowly but steadily fall asleep, your head resting on Brian's chest, both covered by his warm jacket.
target: 于是，你们慢慢、安稳地睡去。你的头靠在布赖恩胸前，两人一起盖着他那件暖和的外套。

source: Eh, %DESTINATION% is cool and all, but spending some quality time with Adrien is cooler.
target: 嗯，%DESTINATION%是不错，可跟阿德里安亲近一会儿，更好。

source: I mean, look at him: a handsome, chivalrous merknight? He's a literal knight in shining armor!
target: 你看看他：英俊又有骑士风度的人鱼骑士！披着闪亮盔甲的梦中骑士，他可是名副其实！

source: Uh... this trip has been an adventure, hasn't it?
target: 呃……这趟旅行，真是场冒险，对吧？

source: Absolutely. And it has been an honor to aid you in such a quest.
target: 当然。能在这趟征途中助你一臂之力，是我的荣幸。

source: Adrien! You always look, like... super tense.
target: 阿德里安，你好像……总是绷得特别紧。

source: When you're a knight fighting against evil, it's hard to lower your guard.
target: 身为对抗邪恶的骑士，很难放下戒备。

source: Maybe you should, from time to time.
target: 也许，偶尔还是该放松一下。

source: I mean, it can't do any good to carry that heavy armor 24/7.
target: 一天二十四小时，每周七天，都穿着那么重的盔甲，怎么会舒服。

source: It is quite heavy armor...
target: 这身盔甲，确实很重……

source: You could always take it off.
target: 你也可以，把它脱掉啊。

source: ...Well, it embarrasses me a bit to admit this, but taking the armor off by myself ranges from hard to outright impossible.
target: ……承认这件事，有点难为情。不过，一个人脱这身盔甲，少说也很困难，甚至可能根本办不到。

source: And you were too shy to ask for help? Cute!
target: 所以，是不好意思开口请人帮忙？真可爱！

source: We didn't know each other that well...
target: 那时候，我们还不太熟……

source: But we do now, don't we?
target: 可现在，已经熟了，不是吗？

source: And so, you start slowly removing Adrien's armor pieces.
target: 于是，你开始一件件，慢慢卸下阿德里安的盔甲。

source: It's a slow process that's quite sensual in its own way.
target: 这过程很慢，也别有一种性感。

source: What's more: as you proceed, Adrien's body reveals itself to be quite toned... which makes sense when you remember that he wears all this armor all the time.
target: 随着盔甲卸下，你发现，他的身材相当结实……想想他一天到晚，都穿着这身重甲，倒也合理。

source: Doesn't it feel good?
target: 是不是舒服多了？

source: It truly does.
target: 确实如此。

source: You shouldn't carry this much weight ALL THE TIME.
target: 这么重的担子，不该一直扛着。

source: Well, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... I guess sometimes it's just a bit hard for me to ask for help.
target: 嗯，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%……我想，我有时就是不太会，开口请人帮忙。

source: I get it.
target: 我懂。

source: But know this: you've helped us a lot, and I gotta say, I like you.
target: 不过，记着，你帮了我们很多。而且，我得说，我喜欢你。

source: So, don't be shy in asking me for anything, okay?
target: 所以，有什么想要的，就跟我开口，别害羞，好吗？

source: ...Anything?
target: ……什么都可以？

source: You get closer to him and whisper:
target: 你靠近他,低声说:

source: Anything.
target: 什么都可以。

source: And so, he asks you for... a thing or two.
target: 于是，他真的向你提了……一两个要求。

source: And thus begins what you could call... this quest's final battle.
target: 这趟征途的……最终之战，就此开始。

source: %DESTINATION%? Sure, but what about spending some quality time with Hope?
target: %DESTINATION%？当然，不过，先跟希望女巫，好好待上一会儿怎么样？

source: She's doing a tarot reading for you.
target: 她正在给你占塔罗牌。

source: And then... the Death card.
target: 接着……死神牌。

source: Oh, no!
target: 哦，不！

source: Nah, don't fret; Death means change... any kind of change...
target: 别紧张，死神代表改变……任何一种改变……

source: A new job... meeting someone new... also actual death, why not?
target: 换份新工作……认识新的人……当然，也可能真是死，为什么不呢？

source: Fingers crossed it's not that one.
target: 但愿不是最后那种。

source: Heh... Yes, let's hope for that.
target: 呵……是啊，但愿不是。

source: But, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, I like to think fate isn't something fixed. Looking into the future is more like getting a glimpse of things that could be.
target: 不过，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我愿意相信，命运不是写死的。窥看未来，更像是瞥见，某种可能。

source: Ultimately, it's up to you to steer the ship in the direction you prefer.
target: 说到底，船要往哪儿走，还是你自己掌舵。

source: These cards? Think of them as a sort of map, a bit of guidance.
target: 这些牌？当成地图就好，给你指个方向。

source: I think I get it.
target: 我觉得我懂了。

source: Change is in my future; but I still get some control over what that might mean.
target: 我未来会有改变。不过，究竟怎么变，我还是能做点主的。

source: Hmmm, yes, in a way.
target: 嗯，算是吧。

source: Like... you know? I've never kissed you... maybe that's the thing that could change.
target: 比如……你知道，我还没亲过你……说不定，这件事可以改变。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!

source: What? This is me taking charge of my future.
target: 怎么？我这是在，掌握自己的未来啊。

source: But if that's not in your cards... I would understand.
target: 不过，要是你的牌里没这回事，我也能理解。

source: Lemme do a tarot reading...
target: 让我占一占……

source: Just kidding.
target: 开玩笑的。

source: Kiss me, you idiot.
target: 亲我，笨蛋。

source: And so, you do. Best tarot reading ever.
target: 于是，你亲了她。史上最棒的塔罗占卜。

source: %DESTINATION% is cool and all that... but you prefer to spend some quality time with Finn.
target: %DESTINATION%是挺好……可你更想，跟芬恩好好待上一会儿。

source: You're giving him a massage, and... dang, his whole back seems made of knots. Poor stressed guy!
target: 你正给他按摩，然后……嚯，整片背好像都绷成了结。可怜的家伙，压力也太大了！

source: Maaaaaan, this feels so good. I NEEDED it. You're a gift sent from Heaven, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%...
target: 伙计——，太舒服了，我太需要这个了。%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，你简直是上天送来的礼物……

source: He places his hand over yours, as you touch his shoulder... it's starting to feel quite intimate... and then his phone starts ringing.
target: 你按着他的肩，他把手覆在你的手上……气氛越来越亲密……然后，手机响了。

source: Ugh... it's a text from Mr. Pappas... he needs me to explain how to use the fax machine.
target: 呃……帕帕斯先生的短信……他要我教他，怎么用传真机。

source: Anyway... where were we?
target: 算了……刚才说到哪儿了？

source: He turns his face towards you. You two are so close... you can almost feel his warm breath as you two look at each other...
target: 他把脸转向你。你们这么近……对望的时候，你几乎能感觉到，他温热的呼吸……

source: ...and then his phone starts ringing like crazy again.
target: ……然后，他的手机，又疯了似的响起来。

source: Aaaaah... what now?
target: 啊……又怎么了？

source: Oof... gimme a minute... he's worried and asking me if it's normal for the fax machine to make so much noise.
target: 唉……等我一下……他在担心，问我，传真机这么吵，是不是正常。

source: Fuck... it's so hard to enjoy little moments like this when you can't put work away...
target: 操……工作一刻都放不下，真难好好享受，这样的小小片刻……

source: You should just do that: put work away... focus on the little moments, like this one...
target: 那就放下啊。先把工作放一边，专心享受，比如现在……

source: It does sound good when you put it like that...
target: 被你这么一说，听起来还真不错……

source: He touches your face, getting even closer to you... slowly...
target: 他摸着你的脸，慢慢……靠得更近……

source: The phone rings.
target: 电话响了

source: UGH!
target: 呃啊！

source: Finn grabs his phone and throws it out of the car.
target: 芬恩抓起手机，直接扔出了车外。

source: Fuck that! And fuck Mr. Pappas! C'mere, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 去他妈的！帕帕斯先生，也去他妈的！过来，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%！

source: Then he grabs your face and kisses you, passionately.
target: 然后，他捧住你的脸，热烈地吻了上来。

source: Whoa, he really needed to release some tension, didn't he?
target: 哇，他可真需要，好好释放一下压力，对吧？

source: And so, you two spend the rest of the night... releasing some tension.
target: 于是，这一夜剩下的时间，你们都用来……好好释放压力。

source: Your fondest memory isn't of %DESTINATION%, but of a night you spent alone with Washing Machine Dahlia.
target: 你最珍惜的回忆，并不是%DESTINATION%，而是与洗衣机达丽雅独处的那个夜晚。

source: This is nice...
target: 这样真好……

source: Yeah...
target: 是啊……

source: Hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, what if you took your clothes off?
target: 嘿，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，要不要把衣服脱了？

source: Ah, so you can wash them, right? It still catches me off-guard when you ask for it.
target: 啊，是为了让你洗，对吧？你每次这么问，我还是会吓一跳。

source: For a moment I thought you meant it as a sex thing...
target: 刚才有那么一瞬间，我还以为你想跟我做点色色的事……

source: Oh, no, this time it's totally a sex thing.
target: 哦，不，这次确实是想跟你做点色色的事。

source: Yeah, I dunno, I like you... I'm pretty sure you like me... so there's that.
target: 嗯，我也不知道怎么说，我喜欢你……我很确定你也喜欢我……所以嘛。

source: Huh... a sex thing. But... how are we supposed to... you know...?
target: 呃……色色的事。可是……我们该怎么……你懂的……？

source: Eh... no idea.
target: 呃……完全没头绪。

source: But I guess that can be half the fun?
target: 不过，摸索的过程不也挺有意思的吗？

source: So, wanna figure it out or what?
target: 所以，要不要一起研究研究？

source: Sure!
target: 当然!

source: And that's the story of how you ended up having sex with a washing machine.
target: 你就是这样，跟一台洗衣机上了床。

source: And you know what? IT. WAS. GOOD.
target: 而且你猜怎么着？爽。到。爆。

source: To think of all the time you wasted not fucking a washing machine...
target: 想想以前那些没跟洗衣机干上一炮的日子，都白过了啊……

source: %DESTINATION%? Who cares about %DESTINATION% when you have none other than the Lamb next to you in a car!
target: %DESTINATION%？身边坐着的可是羔羊本人，谁还在乎%DESTINATION%啊！

source: This is a situation you never imagined could be possible, and yet here you are.
target: 你从没想过这种事真能发生，可它偏偏就发生了。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, I gotta admit: at first I found you uninteresting and just mildly convenient because you own a car.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%，我得承认：一开始我觉得你挺无趣的，只是因为你有车，多少还有点用。

source: I don't own it.
target: 这车不是我的。

source: Shhhhh, lemme finish.
target: 嘘——让我说完。

source: Now I know you are way more than just mildly convenient.
target: 现在我知道了，你可不只是有点用而已。

source: You're reliable and a good listener, and your contralto voice will surely make for some delightful chants.
target: 你靠得住，又愿意听人说话。你那女低音唱起圣歌来，肯定也很动听。

source: Not to mention, I'm sure that one day you'll make a great, delicious corpse.
target: 更别说，我相信有一天，你会成为一具非常出色、非常美味的尸体。

source: Oh, you're saying that just to be nice!
target: 哎呀，你就是嘴甜，哄我开心！

source: No, I mean it.
target: 不,我是认真的。

source: I mean it so much that I want to invite you to join my cult, now that you're done with this road trip.
target: 我可是认真的。既然你的公路旅行结束了，我想邀请你加入我的教团。

source: Oh, this is all so sudden... but I've already been thinking that after so many road misadventures, it was about time for me to settle down.
target: 哦，这也太突然了……不过，经历了这么多路上的倒霉事，我也一直在想，是时候安定下来了。

source: And you know what they say: nothing says "settle down" like joining a cult!
target: 俗话说得好：想安定下来，还有什么比加入邪教更合适呢！

source: (Do they say that?)
target: （有这句俗话吗？）

source: So... yes, Lamb: I will join your cult. And who knows? Maybe there could even be a wedding in our future?
target: 所以……好啊，羔羊，我加入你的教团。谁知道呢？说不定以后我们还能结个婚？

source: Um... sure! I'd be down for a fifth spouse.
target: 呃……好啊！我不介意再多个配偶，凑够五个。

source: We'd only need some time to get to know each other better... and seventy-five bones.
target: 我们只需要花点时间，多了解彼此……再加七十五根骨头。

source: I have some spare bones. I've always said nobody needs this many ribs, anyway.
target: 我有几根多余的骨头。反正我一直觉得，人哪用得着这么多肋骨。

source: Perfect. Then it's settled!
target: 太好了，那就这么定了！

source: Look how excited my followers are that you're joining the cult!
target: 看，我的信徒们一听你要加入教团，多兴奋啊！

source: (Or maybe they just want to eat your corpse, hard to tell.)
target: （也可能只是想吃你的尸体，谁说得准呢。）

source: Fuck yeah!
target: 爽他妈爆！

source: And that's the story of how you joined the Cult of the Lamb.
target: 你就是这样，加入了羔羊教团。
